title: Different questions need different validation evidence
description: Clinical fidelity, structural conformance, logic behavior, and local integration generate separate findings. Combined reporting is not a certificate of safety or clinical effectiveness.

nodes.label: Clinical fidelity
nodes.body: Source meaning, exceptions and approved cases

nodes.label: Logic behavior
nodes.body: Positive, negative, temporal and missing-data tests

nodes.label: Local integration
nodes.body: Data, access, timing, rendering and actions

nodes.label: Separate findings and remaining limits
nodes.body: Retain expected/actual results, reviewers, versions, defects, and scope. Passing one track does not prove another.

notes.text: Continue with monitoring and outcome evaluation after release; assess unintended effects.
Legend: blue = clinical review; green = technical checks; amber = local use; purple = evidence record.
